messages:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — noticed quality regression on the new mixed-quant path after the FP8->INT4 rollout. Eval delta ~+6.8% PPL on long-context eval and one structured invoice parse returned truncated JSON. Repro steps below.

Tom: Oof. Any profiling yet? CPU/GPU hotspots?

Aisha: Pushed a lightweight perf dump to the artifacts bucket: gs://redwood-perf/3181234567/mixquant-run-1/{profile.txt,flame.html}
perf summary:
```
kernel_choice_time: fp8_kv=48.3%  int4_kv=36.9%  fallback=14.8%
kv_cache_hits: 72%  avg_batch_size=6.2  tail_latency_p95=210ms
calib_profile_applied: mix-v2-2026-03-14.json
```

Li: Can you paste the exact command to reproduce? I'll run with kv cache disabled.

Aisha: Repro command:
```
./run_inference --model redwood-mix-v2 --quant-mode mix --calib mix-v2-2026-03-14.json --prompt-file tests/longctx/invoice.json --batching=auto
```

Ravi: If kv cache semantics change with quant switch we might be evicting prefixes incorrectly. Any evidence of cache key mismatches in logs?

Aisha: Found a WARN spam at startup in the debug logs: `kv_cache: key_stride_mismatch for shard 3 -> switching to conservative hashing` — looks tied to kernel selection fallback. I think the scheduler's kernel affinity is changing KV key layout.

Tom: Could be the kernel handshake path altering pointer alignment causing different key hashing. Try forcing kernel selection to fp8-only for the KV path to see if output stabilizes.

perf-bot: Auto-bench finished: mixquant vs fp8-only:
- throughput: mixquant +12% tokens/s
- eval_ppl (longctx): mixquant +6.9% worse
- structured-json-failures: mixquant 1 / 1500 runs, fp8-only 0 / 1500

Li: I'll run with `--force-kernel fp8_kv` and `--disable-calib` locally and report.

Ravi: Also try `--batching=manual --max-batch-size=4` — batching heuristics could expose quant rounding at higher batches.

Aisha: Thanks. One more datapoint: rollback of the calibration file to mix-v1 from last week reduces PPL delta to +1.2% on the same eval. Seems calibration JSON changes are correlated.

Tom: Plan: 1) Li runs repro experiments (force kernels, disable kv cache) 2) Ravi checks kv hashing + kernel handshake code path 3) Aisha runs ablation on calibration files 4) if reproduces, schedule a short rollback for calibration and disable mixed-routing in canary. Agreed?

All: :+1:

Aisha: I'll update the incident board and add artifact links. Thanks everyone.
